selectionRule: All source-declared functions, constructors, fallback and receive declarations in every selected contract, including internal/private functions; preserve refusal, skip, unsupported and failed rows. Compiler-generated getters are listed separately, never silently substituted for source functions. Overloads use source hash, contract, source declaration id and signature, not name alone.

groups.sourceHandling: Use existing upstream fixture parser for multi-source cases and compiler directives; preserve every source unit and oracle. No regex rewriting, reduced corpus or new benchmark-only semantics.

groups.declarations: all returned workloads; retain generated source hashes and original function names

groups.admission: not established; constructor has existing skip annotation; retain it as an unmet admission obligation, not an approved exclusion

groups.rationale: Existing-owner deposit/withdraw custody example. Propose explicitly as the vault representative; not an ERC4626 vault. Preserve its reentrancy-sensitive call and documented default transfer semantics.

groups.admission: not established; legacy Solidity syntax and external calls may require owner fixes. Do not port, trim or replace the original without approval.

modes: fast verdict (native marker, never a theorem)
certified (kernel and transitive axiom audit retained)

measurement.unit: one source declaration and mode per fresh worker process, serial; three measured repetitions
measurement.cache: warm immutable library/compiler artifacts; fresh compiler/frontend/verifier worker for each repetition; source compilation and import/elaboration included, setup build excluded and reported separately
measurement.wall: monotonic elapsed source-to-verdict, including parse, elaboration, walk, closing, all kernel submissions, audit and process overhead; report disjoint phase boundaries and explicit nesting
measurement.memory: peak simultaneous RSS of the entire worker process tree in KiB, including compiler and verifier; record sampling interval and limitations; never label RUSAGE_CHILDREN individual-process maximum as aggregate tree peak
measurement.phaseMemory: record observed tree peak for each disjoint phase; unavailable or incomplete telemetry blocks acceptance, never becomes zero
measurement.identity: record merged measurement head, manifest Git blob, source/adaptor/compiler/toolchain hashes, platform and resource limits; baseline.command reproduces the run
measurement.outcomes: admission must establish exact expected verdict and trust marker for every declaration in both modes before baseline acceptance; upstream EVM vectors, frontend verdicts and Lean proofs remain separate claims; crashes/timeouts/skips/unsupported/missing or ambiguous observations fail completeness
measurement.aggregation: retain all repetitions; per-function wall and RSS budget checks use maximum of three; fast p50/p95 use nearest-rank over per-function maxima, denominator every selected declaration

proposedBudgets.regressionRule: After the first complete approved baseline, fail any declaration/mode when wall exceeds min(absolute mode wall cap, baseline maximum wall * 1.20 + 100 ms), or aggregate tree RSS exceeds min(4194304 KiB, baseline maximum RSS * 1.10 + 16384 KiB). Equality passes. Missing/invalid/nonfinite observations fail. Baseline changes require explicit review; never update it automatically in CI.
proposedBudgets.sizeRule: Report AST statement count and dynamic walk count separately; report time versus size without claiming linearity from static size alone. A numeric linear-growth gate needs calibration and separate approval; this proposal does not assert that property.

releaseDecisionNeeded: Approve these exact groups and budget rules, or return concrete replacements. Record the human decision in the step release note outside this lane lease before freezing an accepted manifest.
implementationDependencies: H148 suite/budget approval remains required; H1620 authorizes proposal only.
Admission for every selected declaration remains unproved; no fixture provenance or compatibility claim is made.

Existing tools have missing disjoint phases, complete kernel coverage and aggregate/phase RSS; implementation requires exact producer interfaces and write-scope authorization outside scripts/bench if those remain unavailable.
CI must run approved suite on merged head and pass; local proposal validation is not CI or U01 acceptance.
